The spawn rate of this mob was reduced in the Nov 06 2011 patch.

'''NOTE:''' The name of this mob changed from '''a ferocious cauldron shark''' to '''a ferocious hammerhead'''.  If this was a classic timeline change then a note should be made to that effect, otherwise this note should be removed.

Based on the above data, each spawn appears to have a roughly 6% chance of being a named (ie. "a ferocious hammerhead"), and each named has roughly a 1 in 6 chance of dropping a chest.

This means a roughly 1% chance of any spawn being a named with a chest, and given the mob's 22-minute respawn time, players have about a 3% chance per hour of getting a chest.
